enabled_in_config.label: Keep track of original state of recap.

schedule.label: Daily local time to generate a recap automatically (HH:MM).
schedule.description: 24-hour local time. Leave empty to generate recaps only on demand. Frigate must be running within a couple of minutes of this time.

window_hours.label: Hours of footage each scheduled recap covers.

max_window_hours.label: Longest time range an on-demand recap may cover.

max_labels.label: Maximum number of time labels on screen at once.

min_label_gap.label: Minimum gap between labels, in pixels at 1080p.

fade_seconds.label: Fade in and out duration for a ghost, its line, and its label.

retain_days.label: Days to keep generated recaps. 0 keeps them until deleted.

replace_superseded.label: Replace an older recap of the same kind when a new one is ready.
replace_superseded.description: On-demand recaps group by window length, such as last 6 hours. Nightly and backfill recaps group by the calendar day in ui.timezone. Running, failed, and archive copies are kept.

output_fps.label: Frame rate of the synopsis video.

sample_fps.label: Frames per second sampled from people and animals.

vehicle_sample_fps.label: Frames per second sampled from vehicles so they stay readable.

min_show_seconds.label: Shortest time a ghost stays on screen.

max_object_seconds.label: Most source time kept for one object (loiterers are trimmed).

max_width.label: Maximum synopsis width. Frames are scaled down to this.

max_events.label: Maximum events processed in one recap.

parked_cars.label: Show a parked car when a person gets in or out of it.

stationary_path.label: Path movement, as a fraction of the frame, below which a vehicle is parked.

delivery_search.label: Tag deliveries with semantic search when Frigate+ labels are absent.

delivery_distance.label: Maximum semantic-search distance to call an event a delivery.

pause_seconds.label: Pause between events so live detection keeps the CPU.

archive.label: Optional external archive of recordings, events, and recaps.

path.label: Filesystem path of the media archive mounted into Frigate.
path.description: Root of a nightly copy that keeps Frigate's layout: recordings/YYYY-MM-DD/HH/<camera>/MM.SS.mp4, clips/, and recap/. Empty disables the filesystem archive.

url.label: Base URL of the media archive.
url.description: Used when the archive is not mounted, or to play a single archived file directly. No trailing slash. Empty disables URL access.
